proposed_urls.rationale: §6B-3-1 Definitions — terms used by the lobbying regime.
§6B-3-2 Registration of lobbyists — core registration requirement.
§6B-3-3 Photograph and information-booklet publication for registered lobbyists.
§6B-3-3a Registration fees.
§6B-3-3b Conflict of interest — lobbyist-specific.
§6B-3-3c Lobbyist training course.
§6B-3-4 Reporting by lobbyists — activity/expenditure disclosure reports.
§6B-3-5 Grass roots lobbying campaigns.
§6B-3-6 Employment of unregistered persons.
§6B-3-7 Duties of lobbyists — conduct and record-keeping.
§6B-3-8 Limitation on persons lobbying in legislative chambers.
§6B-3-9 Penalties — lobbying-specific penalty provisions.
§6B-3-10 Provisions may be adopted by local governments.
§6B-3-11 Compliance audits.
§6B-1-3 Definitions — chapter-wide definitions used by Article 3 lobbying regime.
§6B-1-4 Remedies and penalties in addition to other applicable remedies and penalties — chapter-wide enforcement scaffolding.
§6B-2-1 West Virginia Ethics Commission created — enforcing agency for the lobbying regime.
§6B-2-2 General powers and duties of the Ethics Commission.
§6B-2-2a Probable Cause Review Board — enforcement scaffolding.
§6B-2-3 Advisory opinions; enforcement; applicability; legislative review; rule making.
§6B-2-3a Complaints — complaint mechanism.
§6B-2-4 Processing complaints; dismissals; hearings; disposition; judicial review.
§6B-2-9 Special prosecutor authorized.
§6B-2-10 Violations and penalties — Ethics Commission penalty backbone.

notes: WV uses per-section leaves under article-level TOCs; state→chapter-6b→article-{1,2,3}→section-6b-{1,2,3}-N. Tree depth 4 (one level deeper than the 3-level default), so pass-3 was invoked on each article. Single regime: Chapter 6B Ethics Act houses the lobbying disclosure provisions (Article 3) plus enforcement scaffolding (Articles 1-2); no parallel executive/legislative split. 14 core_chapter URLs (all of Article 3) + 10 support_chapter URLs (definitions/penalties in Article 1; Ethics Commission enforcement chain in Article 2, excluding officials' financial-disclosure sections 5/5a/5b/5c/6/7/8 and empty §6B-2-11). Matches WV 2010 prior shape (27 URLs) — 2015 returned 24, with the 3-URL gap explained by tighter Article 1/2 filtering (only definitions + penalty/enforcement scaffolding rather than full articles).
